== Summary ==
The front door of [[Bastian Winkelhaus]]'s home, decorated by his friends for his return as [[2018 World Championship]] champion: a Darth Vader cut-out with his face, a "World Championship 2018 Champion" sign and the Star Wars CCG logo.

* '''Event:''' [[2018 World Championship]] (homecoming)
* '''Date posted:''' 2018-10-13
* '''Image:''' native forum attachment, 3024×4032, EXIF orientation applied; the doorbell name plate and house number are blurred for privacy.

== Source ==
Posted on the Players Committee forum: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1224616#p1224616 post 1224616] in topic 70815 ("Safely back home"), by Death Star ([[Bastian Winkelhaus]]), 13 October 2018. He wrote that this was the reception his friends gave him on getting home from the [[2018 World Championship]]: friends "who have no idea what SWCCG actually is, but who are seemingly very proud of me". Original attachment name: 762E7942-004C-4AA6-9846-9EBB24180CD5.jpeg; forum attachment id 7525. Preserved copy: pending (#1310). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261124145838/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1224616.html Internet Archive]
* '''Posted by:''' Death Star (Bastian Winkelhaus)
